commits.edited_message:
posix: validate arguments and clarify allocation sizing

Validate REG_STARTEND offsets and NULL pointer arguments. Also make the C-string allocation helper take the complete allocation size.

coupling: Commit 7830094c introduces MEMCTL_MALLOC_CSTRING with payload-plus-terminator semantics and safely moves the older substring allocation to it. Commit 4fb2f0c adopts that helper for every PCRE2_COPY_MATCHED_SUBJECT allocation, passing the payload length; this remains safe under the helper introduced by 7830094c. Commit 2d3a98a9 then changes the helper to exact allocation-size semantics and updates the pre-existing substring consumer, but the copied-subject consumers added by 4fb2f0c still pass payload length. The final allocation is therefore one code unit short, and the terminator write at subject[length] is out of bounds. A correct fix must reconcile the later exact-size contract with the calls adopted in 4fb2f0c (or preserve the earlier payload contract consistently); reasoning about only one of the three commits leaves an incompatible allocation contract across the helper and its consumers.
